content: नृ [नी-ऋन् डिच्च; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 2. 101</ls>] (<ab>Nom.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> ना, <ab>gen.</ab> <ab>pl.</ab> नृणाम् or नॄणाम्) .²1 A man, a person whether male or female; <ls>Ms. 3. 81</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 61</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 61</ls>; नॄन् प्रशंसत्यजस्रं यो घण्टाताडोरुणोदये <ls n="Ms.">10. 33</ls>. .²2 Mankind. .²3 A piece at chess. .²4 The pin of a sun-dial. .²5 A masculine word; संधिर्ना विग्रहो यानम् <ls>Ak.</ls> .²6 A leader.
